title: Why Oil Prices Don't Always Crash in Chaos
one_idea: OPEC actively regulates the global oil supply like a thermostat to keep prices stable during political conflict.
audience_misconception: People think oil prices react purely to news headlines, not realizing a central cartel actively regulates supply to counter panic.

analogy.source_term: OPEC acts like a home thermostat, adjusting the flow of oil to keep global prices stable.
analogy.limitation: Unlike real oil, Barnaby's juice doesn't take millions of years to make.

claims.claim: OPEC and its allies decided to keep oil output steady on October 4, 2026, despite escalating Middle East tensions.
